cards.b: A set of step-by-step instructions that solves a problem or completes a task.
Breaking a problem down into smaller, more manageable sub-problems.
Removing or hiding unnecessary detail so only the important features remain, e.g. a tube map.
Sequence (in order), selection (choose using a condition) and iteration (repeat in a loop).
The four things to identify when analysing a problem: data in, results out, calculations/decisions, and starting values.
A rounded box (terminator) marks the start and end of an algorithm.
A rectangle: an action or calculation, e.g. add 1 to Count.
A diamond with two exits labelled Yes/No (True/False).
A rectangle with double side lines: a step defined in a separate flowchart.
FOR Index FROM 1 TO 10 DO … END FOR (both ends included; optional STEP).
Otherwise it starts with an unknown value and every later total is wrong.
An algorithm that meets the stated requirements, gives correct output for valid data and works efficiently.

short.q: Explain what is meant by abstraction and give an example.
short.model: Abstraction removes unnecessary detail so only the important features are kept. For example, a tube map shows stations and links but not real distances or streets.

short.q: A program must run a quiz. Describe how decomposition could be used.
short.model: Split it into smaller tasks such as choosing questions, asking each question, checking the answer and showing the score. Each task can be written and tested as its own subprogram.
points: each can be a separate subprogram/tested separately

short.q: State what this does: SET T TO 0, RECEIVE N, WHILE N <> 0 add N to T and RECEIVE N again, then SEND T.
short.model: It adds up the numbers entered until the user enters 0, then displays the total.
points: stops at 0 and displays the total

short.q: Write pseudocode to display 'Adult' if Age is 18 or more, otherwise 'Child'.
short.model: IF Age >= 18 THEN SEND 'Adult' TO DISPLAY ELSE SEND 'Child' TO DISPLAY END IF.
points: correct output in both branches using ELSE

short.q: A program should average 5 marks but the loop runs FOR Index FROM 1 TO 4 and Total is never set to 0. Give two errors.
short.model: The loop runs only 4 times instead of 5, and Total is not initialised to 0 before the loop.
